tokens.name: fresh-grass
tokens.usage: Primary brand accent: navigation strokes, card borders, decorative highlights, the accent button fill. Decorative on light grounds (1.58:1 on cream-paper) — never text, never the only signal of state. Put ink-black text on it (7.67:1).

tokens.name: cream-paper
tokens.usage: Page canvas and soft card surface. Replaces white as the structural background. Also the text color on ink-black fills (12.14:1).

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Primary text, icons, nav borders and the default hairline border. Body copy on cream-paper (12.14:1), pure-white (13.71:1) and sandstone (9.92:1). Fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: pure-white
tokens.usage: Highest surface: elevated cards, the floating nav, inset content blocks. Text color on dark illustration grounds.

tokens.name: sandstone
tokens.usage: Recessed or secondary surface, one step deeper than cream-paper. Also the disabled button fill.

tokens.name: stone-gray
tokens.usage: Muted text and secondary link borders. Source pair kept exact: 3.43:1 on cream-paper, 3.88:1 on pure-white — passes only for text 24px+ or bold 19px+ and for borders. Use ink-black for muted text below that size.

tokens.name: hairline-mist
tokens.usage: Subtle nav dividers and low-contrast structural lines. Decorative only (1.30:1 on cream-paper): never a control's sole boundary.

tokens.name: pure-ink
tokens.usage: Icon fills, maximum-contrast text and borders where ink-black is not enough (18.58:1 on cream-paper).

tokens.name: sky-pop
tokens.usage: Illustration accent, card border accent and the small dot in icons. Decorative on light grounds (2.45:1 on cream-paper); ink-black text on a sky-pop fill reads at 4.95:1.

tokens.name: coral-pop
tokens.usage: Outline accent for tags, dividers and focused UI edges. Never the primary CTA color. Source value kept: 2.40:1 on cream-paper, under the 3:1 border floor — pair a coral outline with ink-black text so meaning never rests on the outline alone.

tokens.name: sunshine-pop
tokens.usage: Footer highlight and illustration accent, used sparingly for warmth. Background only; ink-black text on it reads at 10.30:1.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Surface level 0 — the page canvas.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Surface level 1 — elevated cards, floating navigation, inset content blocks.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Surface level 2 — recessed or secondary surface tone.

styles.name: 5xl-4
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. The only regular-weight display step.

styles.name: 5xl
styles.usage: Page titles and big card headlines.

styles.name: lg-2
styles.usage: Short lead copy and nav brand, tracked tight.

styles.name: lg-3
styles.sample: Comfortable reading copy for longer paragraphs.

styles.name: lg-4
styles.usage: List items and compact single lines.

styles.name: lg-5
styles.usage: Footer and stacked link lists with generous rhythm.

styles.name: lg
styles.usage: Supporting body copy and card descriptions.

styles.name: base
styles.usage: UI text: buttons, nav links, tags, form labels.

styles.name: xs
styles.usage: Micro-labels and legal fine print only; ink-black, never stone-gray.

spacing.note: A 4px base unit with a few large jumps. Source keys were bare numbers; they are prefixed here so the CSS variables read clearly.

tokens.name: space-unit
tokens.usage: Base unit; build in-between values (8, 12, 16px) as multiples of it.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters, gap between buttons and tags.

tokens.name: space-60
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-136
tokens.usage: Vertical padding between page sections.

tokens.name: space-216
tokens.usage: Hero top padding and the largest editorial breaks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Small controls, inputs, image thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards and content blocks.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Large feature cards and illustration frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: buttons and tags.

tokens.name: radius-full-2
tokens.usage: The floating navigation bar.
